## T1 {slot: hook, fig: none}
When an AI agent says it "remembers" you, is that architecture or a marketing word?[narrative]
This filing answers with a five-step loop, and step two reads a per-user store of memory objects built from your prior chats.[M1,M2,M3,M4,M5,M6,M53]
That store is drawn as a box of its own.[M117]

## T2 {slot: stop, fig: none}
What the datastore holds is not a transcript.[M107]
Its unit is the memory object, a container holding one or more memory values: strings, images, or audio.[M30,M81,M118]
Beside each value sits metadata: a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, a summary of the interaction.[M17,M68]

## T3 {slot: stop, fig: none}
Who decides what the agent keeps?[narrative]
A model does.[M13,M64]
In a memory update cycle, cached inputs go to the model, which predicts what to remember, extracts it, and writes it as a memory object.[M14,M15,M16,M65,M66,M67,M121]
Saying "remember this" is one trigger, and the write can run offline.[M19,M70,M112,M120]

## T4 {slot: stop, fig: none}
Recall is not a reread of everything.[M12,M63]
In the recall cycle, the agent scores stored objects against the query, comparing embeddings by a measure like cosine similarity.[M26,M28,M77,M79]
Only a top subset comes back, ordered by timestamp so the model sees what is recent.[M24,M27,M75,M78,M115,M119]

## T5 {slot: stop, fig: none}
Memories can be corrected.[M40,M43]
New input arrives with a timestamp, is matched to a prior memory object, and either replaces it or updates it.[M39,M40,M42,M43,M90,M91,M93,M94]
Aligned objects can be consolidated into one, so new information refines a memory instead of noisily overwriting it.[M36,M87,M109]

## T6 {slot: pivot, fig: none}
Forgetting is claimed, not just remembering.[M20,M21]
"Forget that" deletes the specified information from the datastore.[M20,M21,M71,M72]
"Forget this after three months" queues it for deletion.[M22,M23,M73]
Expired objects are swept in maintenance, and the same chat erases what it built.[M74,M110,M111,M122]

## T7 {slot: stop, fig: none}
Before answering, the model can analyze your query against the recalled memory.[M34,M85]
That analysis is not shown on screen.[M35,M86]
The response itself can be an API call that makes a device act, so memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.[M44,M113]

## T8 {slot: landing, fig: none}
There are no benchmark numbers here.[M116]
The claimed difference is structural: memory objects made from your own interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you ask.[M3,M12,M21,M40,M116]
That is an architecture you can read, not a slogan.[narrative]

## T9 {slot: tail, fig: none}
The filing is WO2026-128750A1, with a 2024 priority and a 2026 publication.[M103,M104,M106]
Follow along for the next patent walk-through.[narrative]"}}
